title: Alert:Avoid the next version of Android Q
body:
Thank you for playing My Sweet Roomies.

There is a problem occurring on My Sweet Roomies! after updating Android OS of your device to 'Android Q.' Your data will be deleted when you start this game after you update the device OS to Android Q.

We will not be able to restore your previous data. Please avoid to get Android Q on your device to play My Sweet Roomies.

title: Game Closure Notice
body:
Thank you for playing My Sweet Roomies. We have made the tough decision to close My Sweet Roomies on November 13, 2019. It was hard to come to this decision, but despite efforts to keep the game, it has not quite seen the success we had hoped for. We would like you all to know that we thank our loyal players and hope you have enjoyed your time with the game as much as we have.

Here is the schedule over the next few months (times in JST):

On 9/4 12PM
Terminate Earning Free Bronze Tickets.

On 10/2 12PM
All in App Purchases will have disabled.
Monthly Course will stop to accept new subscription.

*If you have subscribed any of Standard/Special/Deluxe Courses, they are valid until the expiration date. Also, your subscription will not be renewed after October 2nd.

On 11/13 12PM
The game will be removed from Google Play and closed.
You can use Crystals till 11/13 12PM.
After the closure of the game, you cannot play My Sweet Roomies.

Also, in case you need a help after the closure of the app, we recommend you to record your User ID as taking screen capture of your User ID and number of remaining Crystals.

You can check your User ID as below.
Menu -> More -> HELP -> "How much crystals I have left?" -> "You can check it from Here!"

We really appreciate the support you have given us. We hope for your understanding and your patience in the coming weeks.

With sincerest regrets,

My Sweet Roomies team

My Sweet Roomies Closing Q&A
When will the game close?
The game will be open until 12PM on November 13, 2019 (JST).

Is there a chance that My Sweet Roomies may reopen?
There are no plans for bringing it back at the moment.

If I want to, can I still make purchases?
You cannot make In App Purchases after 12PM on October 2nd. However, you can use Crystals until November 13 (JST).

Can I still download the game?
The game will be removed from Google Play on November 13, 2019 (JST). You will still be able to play the game until November 13.

Can I move my account to a different version?
